example_en: The library's online catalogue makes it easy to locate rare books.
example_cn: 图书馆的在线目录让人能轻松找到珍本书籍。
note: catalogue 作名词常与 online、library 搭配；美式拼写为 catalog。

example_en: Under the city charter, public funds cannot be spent without a vote.
example_cn: 根据城市宪章，未经投票通过不得动用公共资金。
note: under the charter 指依宪章规定；charter 作动词还可表示包租。

example_en: Tax breaks provide a strong incentive for companies to invest in clean energy.
example_cn: 税收减免为企业投资清洁能源提供了强有力的激励。
note: incentive for sb. to do sth. 为固定搭配，常与 strong、financial 连用。

example_en: Only a small elite could afford such an expensive education in the past.
example_cn: 过去只有少数精英才负担得起如此昂贵的教育。
note: the elite 指精英阶层；也可作定语，如 elite universities（顶尖大学）。

example_en: Whether to ban cars from the city centre remains a controversial issue.
example_cn: 是否禁止汽车进入市中心仍是一个有争议的问题。
note: highly controversial 是常见搭配，比 debatable 语气更强。

example_en: Every online transaction is recorded so that customers can check their bills.
example_cn: 每笔线上交易都有记录，顾客可以核对账单。
note: transaction 指一笔交易，常与 carry out、process、record 搭配。

example_en: Three witnesses agreed to testify against the driver in court.
example_cn: 三名目击者同意出庭指证那名司机。
note: testify against sb. 指作不利证词；testify to sth. 意为证明某事。

example_en: Heavy traffic keeps many residential streets noisy late into the night.
example_cn: 繁忙的交通让许多住宅街道直到深夜都很吵。
note: residential area 指住宅区，与 commercial、industrial 相对。

example_en: After entering the Asian market, the firm's annual turnover doubled.
example_cn: 进入亚洲市场后，这家公司的年营业额翻了一番。
note: annual turnover 指年营业额；staff turnover 指员工流失率。

example_en: Inevitably, the rapid expansion of the city has squeezed green space.
example_cn: 城市的快速扩张不可避免地挤压了绿地。
note: inevitably 多放句首或实义动词前，表示结果无法避免。

example_en: For selling alcohol to teenagers, the shop owner was fined by a magistrate.
example_cn: 由于向青少年售酒，店主被地方法官处以罚款。
note: magistrate 在英国多指基层治安法官，负责处理轻微案件。

example_en: Both sides issued a joint declaration promising to reduce tariffs.
example_cn: 双方发表联合声明，承诺降低关税。
note: joint declaration 指联合声明，动词常搭配 issue、sign。

example_en: As a competitor, she studies her rivals' products before every launch.
example_cn: 作为竞争者，她每次发布产品前都会研究对手的产品。
note: competitor 指竞争对手，常与 main、direct、biggest 连用。

example_en: Cutting carbon emissions is the surest way to slow global warming.
example_cn: 削减碳排放是减缓全球变暖最可靠的办法。
note: emission 多用复数 emissions 指废气排放，动词搭配 cut、reduce。

example_en: It was the bishop who persuaded the king to spare the village.
example_cn: 正是主教说服国王放过了那个村庄。
note: bishop 指主教；国际象棋中的象也用这个词，但语境完全不同。

example_en: Her elegant handwriting made the old letters a pleasure to read.
example_cn: 她娟秀的字迹让那些旧信读起来赏心悦目。
note: elegant 常修饰服饰、设计或举止；elegant solution 指巧妙的方案。

example_en: Before shooting began, the screenwriter rewrote the script four times.
example_cn: 开机之前，编剧把剧本改了四遍。
note: film script 指电影剧本；script 还可指文字的书写系统。

example_en: Add two cloves of garlic and let the sauce simmer for a while.
example_cn: 加两瓣大蒜，让酱汁慢慢炖一会儿。
note: a clove of garlic 指一瓣大蒜；garlic 是不可数名词。

example_en: Does the battery have the capability to last a full working day?
example_cn: 这块电池能撑过一整天的工作吗？
note: have the capability to do sth. 比 can 更正式，多用于技术语境。

example_en: Thanks to his athletic ability, he earned a place in the national team.
example_cn: 凭借运动天赋，他在国家队赢得了一席之地。
note: athletic 修饰 ability、talent、meeting；athletics 指田径运动。

example_en: We hired her for her expertise in renewable energy systems.
example_cn: 我们聘用她，是因为她在可再生能源系统方面有专长。
note: expertise 不可数，常与 technical、professional、medical 搭配。

example_en: Time constraints forced the team to cut several planned experiments.
example_cn: 时间上的限制迫使团队砍掉了几个原定的实验。
note: constraint on sth. 指对某事的限制，常与 financial、time 连用。

example_en: Astronomers have discovered a distant galaxy that formed soon after the Big Bang.
example_cn: 天文学家发现了一个在宇宙大爆炸后不久形成的遥远星系。
note: galaxy 指星系，the Galaxy 特指银河系；也可指一群显赫人物。

example_en: What is most striking about the report is its complete lack of evidence.
example_cn: 这份报告最引人注目的是它完全没有证据。
note: striking 常修饰 contrast、difference、similarity，表示显著的差别。

example_en: The building was formerly a factory and is now an art museum.
example_cn: 这座建筑以前是工厂，如今成了美术馆。
note: formerly 与 now 常对照使用，位置多在 be 动词之后。

example_en: More money was allocated to rural schools this year than last.
example_cn: 今年拨给农村学校的资金比去年多。
note: allocate sth. to sb./sth. 为固定结构，名词形式是 allocation。

example_en: The orchestra gave a superb performance despite the poor acoustics.
example_cn: 尽管音响效果不佳，乐团的演出依然极为精彩。
note: superb 比 very good 更书面，常修饰 view、quality、performance。

example_en: The report alleges that the firm hid evidence of water pollution.
example_cn: 该报道称这家公司隐瞒了水污染的证据。
note: allege 常用于 it is alleged that 结构，暗示消息尚未证实。

example_en: Visitors can still walk along the medieval walls that surround the city.
example_cn: 游客仍能沿着环绕城市的中世纪城墙漫步。
note: medieval 指欧洲五至十五世纪，常修饰 castle、town、art。

example_en: A careful evaluation showed that the policy had helped few families.
example_cn: 仔细的评估表明，该政策帮助过的家庭很少。
note: evaluation of sth. 是常用结构；动词 evaluate 直接接宾语。

example_en: Having withdrawn the product, the company subsequently apologised to buyers.
example_cn: 公司撤回产品后，向买家道了歉。
note: subsequently 与 later 同义但更正式，多用于叙述事件先后。

example_en: Leaking the private emails undermined public trust in the whole department.
example_cn: 泄露私人邮件损害了公众对整个部门的信任。
note: undermine 常与 confidence、authority、trust 搭配，指暗中削弱。

example_en: Smart speakers raise serious questions about privacy in the home.
example_cn: 智能音箱引发了有关家庭隐私的严重问题。
note: privacy 不可数，常见搭配 invade、protect、respect one's privacy。

example_en: The city has spent millions trying to combat air pollution.
example_cn: 这座城市已花费数百万用于治理空气污染。
note: combat 作动词直接接宾语，如 combat crime、combat pollution。

example_en: Before signing the contract, his client sought counsel from a lawyer.
example_cn: 签合同之前，他的当事人向律师寻求了意见。
note: seek counsel 指寻求建议；counsel 也可指辩护律师，单复数同形。

example_en: We need a realistic plan that fits our budget and our time.
example_cn: 我们需要一个既符合预算又符合时间的可行计划。
note: realistic 常修饰 plan、goal、expectation，反义词是 unrealistic。

example_en: Behind the policy lies a clear ideology of personal responsibility.
example_cn: 这项政策的背后是一套清晰的个人责任观念。
note: ideology 指系统的观念体系，常与 political、dominant 搭配。

example_en: During his presidency, the country joined three major trade agreements.
example_cn: 在他任总统期间，该国加入了三项重要的贸易协定。
note: win the presidency、run for the presidency 是常见搭配。

example_en: Her memoir offers a moving narrative of growing up in wartime.
example_cn: 她的回忆录讲述了一个战时成长的动人故事。
note: narrative of sth. 指关于某事的叙述；也可作定语，如 narrative style。

example_en: He strongly denied allegations that he had misused public money.
example_cn: 他坚决否认了有关他滥用公款的指控。
note: allegation 常与 deny、dismiss、investigate 搭配，语气弱于 charge。

example_en: Turn left at the next junction and follow the signs to the station.
example_cn: 在下一个路口左转，然后跟着指示牌去车站。
note: junction 指道路或铁路的交会处，常用 at the junction of 结构。

example_en: For centuries the imperial court controlled the salt trade.
example_cn: 几个世纪以来，朝廷控制着盐的贸易。
note: imperial 修饰 court、palace、power，指与皇权相关的。

example_en: Despite repeated assurances, the repairs were never actually carried out.
example_cn: 尽管一再得到保证，维修工作实际上从未进行。
note: give an assurance that... 比 promise 更正式，常见于新闻报道。

example_en: On warm evenings the restaurant's terrace fills up long before sunset.
example_cn: 天气暖和的傍晚，这家餐厅的露台在日落前很久就坐满了。
note: terrace 指露台或梯田，如 rice terraces（水稻梯田）。

example_en: In the final chapter the author asserts that slow reading improves memory.
example_cn: 在最后一章，作者断言慢读能提升记忆力。
note: assert 后可接 that 从句；assert oneself 意为坚持自己的权利。

example_en: Farmers owe much of their success to innovation in irrigation.
example_cn: 农民的成功在很大程度上归功于灌溉方面的创新。
note: innovation 可数指新事物，不可数指创新过程，常与 encourage 连用。

example_en: In 1997 the old town was listed as a world heritage site.
example_cn: 1997 年，这座古镇被列为世界遗产地。
note: heritage 多指文化遗产，如 cultural heritage，通常不可数。

example_en: Few politicians leave a legacy as admired as her education reforms.
example_cn: 很少有政治家能留下像她的教育改革那样受人敬重的遗产。
note: legacy 多指抽象的精神或制度遗产，常与 leave、lasting 搭配。

example_en: Is it legitimate for companies to track what employees do online?
example_cn: 公司追踪员工上网行为是否正当？
note: legitimate 修饰 right、reason、concern，兼指合法与合理。

example_en: Clusters of bright stars are visible on any clear winter night.
example_cn: 在晴朗的冬夜能看到一团团明亮的星星。
note: a cluster of 后接可数名词复数；动词 cluster 表示聚集在某处。

example_en: Charges of fraud cost the firm its licence and its reputation.
example_cn: 欺诈指控让这家公司失去了执照和声誉。
note: fraud 常与 commit、investigate、charge with 搭配，指诈骗行为。

example_en: The photograph depicts a crowded market just after the rain.
example_cn: 这张照片描绘了雨后不久一个拥挤的市场。
note: depict 指用文字或图像描绘，也可用 depict sth. as... 结构。

example_en: The new rule provoked angry protests from parents and teachers alike.
example_cn: 新规定激起了家长和老师同样愤怒的抗议。
note: provoke 常接 anger、debate、criticism，指引发强烈反应。

example_en: The driving instructor told me to check the mirror before every turn.
example_cn: 驾校教练让我每次转弯前都看一下后视镜。
note: instructor 指技能教练或大学讲师，比 teacher 更强调专业训练。

example_en: The two nations finally settled the dispute through diplomatic channels.
example_cn: 两国最终通过外交渠道解决了争端。
note: diplomatic channels 指外交渠道；形容人时意为圆通、得体的。

example_en: Inadequate sleep affects memory, mood and the ability to concentrate.
example_cn: 睡眠不足会影响记忆、情绪和注意力。
note: inadequate 后接 for sth. 或 to do sth.，常与 badly 连用。

example_en: So overwhelming was the evidence against the plan that it was dropped.
example_cn: 反对该计划的证据十分有力，因此计划被搁置了。
note: overwhelming majority、overwhelming evidence 是常见搭配。

example_en: For the residents, the constant noise has become a nightly nightmare.
example_cn: 对居民来说，持续不断的噪音已成了每晚的噩梦。
note: a nightmare for sb. 指某人的噩梦，也可形容极棘手的局面。

example_en: Her conception of success changed after she spent a year volunteering.
example_cn: 在做了一年志愿服务后，她对成功的理解改变了。
note: conception of sth. 指对某事的看法，have no conception of 表示完全不懂。

example_en: Government spending acted as a stimulus to the depressed local economy.
example_cn: 政府支出对萧条的地方经济起到了刺激作用。
note: stimulus 复数为 stimuli，常与 give、provide、act as 搭配。

example_en: Her latest book portrays the war through a child's eyes.
example_cn: 她的新书通过一个孩子的眼睛来描绘战争。
note: portray 可直接接宾语，也常用 portray sb. as... 表示把某人刻画成……。

example_en: Digital media have changed the nature of public discourse about science.
example_cn: 数字媒体改变了公众科学讨论的性质。
note: discourse on sth. 指围绕某话题的讨论，多见于学术语境。

example_en: For nearly three weeks the crew were held hostage by the rebels.
example_cn: 船员被叛军扣为人质近三周。
note: take/hold sb. hostage 为固定说法，hostage 前不加冠词。

example_en: Her clothes filled the closet and spilled onto two chairs.
example_cn: 她的衣服塞满了壁橱，还堆到了两把椅子上。
note: closet 指嵌在墙内的储物柜，英式英语中多说 wardrobe。

example_en: What makes the village distinctive is its brightly painted wooden houses.
example_cn: 这座村庄的独特之处在于那些色彩鲜艳的木屋。
note: distinctive 强调与众不同的特点，与 distinct（清楚可辨）不同。

example_en: Doctors suggest eating more fiber to keep the heart healthy.
example_cn: 医生建议多吃纤维以保持心脏健康。
note: fiber 不可数，dietary fiber 指膳食纤维；英式拼作 fibre。

example_en: At sunset the view from the top of the cliff is spectacular.
example_cn: 悬崖顶上的景色在日落时分十分壮观。
note: spectacular 可修饰 view、success、failure，语气比 impressive 强。

example_en: Antibiotics should never be taken without a doctor's prescription.
example_cn: 绝不应在没有医生处方的情况下服用抗生素。
note: write a prescription 指开处方；fill a prescription 指按方配药。

example_en: A single careless comment can trigger a long argument online.
example_cn: 一句随意的评论就可能在网络上引发一场长久的争论。
note: trigger 作动词指突然引发，常接 crisis、debate、change。

example_en: There is now broad consensus that the old bridge must be rebuilt.
example_cn: 现在人们普遍认为这座旧桥必须重建。
note: reach a consensus on sth.；consensus 前用 a，不用 the。

example_en: Many streets in the old quarter still carry colonial names.
example_cn: 老城区的许多街道至今仍沿用殖民时期的名称。
note: colonial 修饰 rule、period、architecture，指与殖民统治相关的。

example_en: A warm bath before bed may induce sleep more effectively than a pill.
example_cn: 睡前洗个热水澡可能比吃药更能帮助入睡。
note: induce sb. to do sth. 为固定搭配；也可指引起某种生理反应。

example_en: He was convicted of fraud and sentenced to four years.
example_cn: 他因诈骗被判有罪，获刑四年。
note: convict sb. of sth. 为固定结构；作名词时重音在前。

example_en: Treating the symptoms will not remove the underlying problem.
example_cn: 只治疗症状并不能解决根本问题。
note: underlying 修饰 cause、problem、reason，强调表面之下的根本原因。

example_en: Because of the sheer complexity of the process, many applicants give up.
example_cn: 由于程序极其复杂，许多申请者放弃了。
note: the complexity of sth. 常用单数；complexities 指各种复杂问题。

example_en: Members will hold a ballot on whether to accept the new contract.
example_cn: 会员将就是否接受新合同进行投票。
note: by secret ballot 指无记名投票；cast a ballot 意为投票。

example_en: A marginal rise in wages did little to reduce poverty.
example_cn: 工资的小幅上涨对减少贫困几乎没起作用。
note: marginal 常修饰 improvement、increase、difference，表幅度很小。

example_en: He murmured a few words of thanks and left the room quietly.
example_cn: 他低声说了几句感谢的话，然后悄悄离开了房间。
note: a murmur of approval/agreement 指低声表达的赞同。

example_en: Its sheer size makes the cathedral impossible to photograph in one frame.
example_cn: 大教堂规模宏大，无法用一张照片拍全。
note: by sheer luck 为固定搭配；sheer 也可形容崖壁陡峭。

example_en: She curled up on the couch with a blanket and a novel.
example_cn: 她裹着毯子、拿着一本小说，蜷在沙发上。
note: couch 与 sofa 基本同义，美式口语中 couch 更常用。

example_en: Many adolescents spend more time online than they do sleeping.
example_cn: 许多青少年上网的时间比睡觉的时间还长。
note: adolescent 作定语指青春期的；作名词比 teenager 正式。

example_en: Environmental groups continue to lobby for stricter limits on plastic waste.
example_cn: 环保团体继续游说，要求对塑料垃圾实行更严格的限制。
note: lobby for sth. 指游说支持某事；lobby 作名词指酒店或剧院的大厅。

example_en: After the accident he was physically unable to work for months.
example_cn: 事故之后，他身体上有好几个月无法工作。
note: physically demanding 指体力消耗大，反义为 mentally demanding。

example_en: Insurance premiums rise sharply for drivers with repeated accidents.
example_cn: 屡次出事故的司机保险费会大幅上涨。
note: pay a premium for sth. 指为某物多付钱；insurance premium 指保费。

example_en: In this village tea drinking is a ritual passed down for generations.
example_cn: 在这个村子里，喝茶是世代相传的仪式。
note: ritual 指固定仪式或习惯性程序，常与 daily、morning 连用。

example_en: Each autumn salmon return to this river to lay their eggs.
example_cn: 每年秋天，鲑鱼都会洄游到这条河产卵。
note: salmon 单复数同形；smoked salmon 指烟熏鲑鱼。

example_en: Who initiated the discussion about changing the school timetable?
example_cn: 是谁发起了关于更改学校课程表的讨论？
note: initiate a project/reform 指发起项目或改革，比 start 正式。

example_en: There is no need to panic; the train will arrive in ten minutes.
example_cn: 不必惊慌，火车十分钟后就到。
note: panic 过去式为 panicked，现在分词 panicking，须保留 k。

example_en: Carved from a single block of stone, the sculpture attracts many visitors.
example_cn: 这座雕塑由一整块石头雕成，吸引了许多游客。
note: sculpture 可数指具体作品，不可数指雕塑艺术。

example_en: The dish has a subtle flavour that grows on you slowly.
example_cn: 这道菜味道清淡微妙，慢慢就让人喜欢上了。
note: subtle 常修饰 difference、change、flavour，副词形式是 subtly。

example_en: She took up photography seriously after retiring from thirty years of teaching.
example_cn: 教书三十年退休之后，她开始认真学摄影。
note: photography 不可数，指摄影术；photograph 指一张照片。

example_en: Failure to comply with safety rules may result in a heavy fine.
example_cn: 不遵守安全规定可能导致高额罚款。
note: comply with sth. 为固定搭配，名词 compliance 同样接 with。

example_en: Since the old machine is beyond repair, we ordered a replacement.
example_cn: 由于这台旧机器无法修好，我们订了一台新的。
note: a replacement for sth. 指替代品；in need of replacement 表示需要更换。

example_en: Breaking the company's monopoly on electricity would lower prices.
example_cn: 打破这家公司对电力的垄断会降低电价。
note: have a monopoly on sth. 指垄断某物；动词是 monopolize。

example_en: Is it ethical to test new drugs on people who cannot pay?
example_cn: 在无力支付的人身上测试新药合乎道德吗？
note: ethical 指合乎伦理的，常与 issue、concern、standard 搭配。

example_en: Their villa stands on a hill above the fishing village.
example_cn: 他们的别墅坐落在渔村上方的一座小山上。
note: villa 指度假别墅或带花园的住宅，多见于欧洲语境。

example_en: A scientist of great integrity refused to sign the false report.
example_cn: 一位极为正直的科学家拒绝在那份虚假报告上签字。
note: integrity 不可数，既指品格正直，也指 data integrity（完整性）。

example_en: Our sales figures are higher than those of our European counterparts.
example_cn: 我们的销售额高于欧洲同行。
note: counterpart 指职位或功能相当的对应者，如 my counterpart in Japan。

example_en: In essence, good teaching means helping students think for themselves.
example_cn: 本质上，好的教学就是帮助学生独立思考。
note: in essence 意为本质上；of the essence 表示至关重要。

example_en: Currency traders watch central bank decisions more closely than anyone.
example_cn: 外汇交易员比任何人都更密切地关注央行的决定。
note: trader 指从事买卖的人，如 street trader、currency trader。
